claims.statement: The built-in personal Assistant is available by default as a persistent Agent, initialized idle from the sidebar or selected from existing Agents in Work. It has stable identity, typed tools, teams and independent wakes. Native Codex remains the executor; protocol is 4.8 and database schema is 61.

The selected Assistant can create an independent persistent Agent under an exact delivered user delegation. Initial instructions retain application provenance and linked user authority. Existing Work and scoped Collaboration own outcome assignment and assessment.

The existing service tick delivers independent duties through the Inbox. Turn preparation injects a compact Work directory; fresh contexts receive current state and recent original exchanges across native contexts instead of recursive summaries.
Native memory inspection reads an already-loaded thread without generation or policy changes; isolated native tests set memory generation and use independently in thread-start configuration.

Renewal defaults to 24 completed turns and an 80 percent native-context pressure trigger when enabled. Safe boundaries retain native request, Goal, voice, retry and child ownership. Exact question answers and canonical edited inputs remain in their original native context.

Renewal records intent before a clean native thread/start, saves the acknowledgment before dependent work, atomically changes the stable Agent binding and retains old history. Unknown creation uses exact loaded native source markers for reconciliation and is never blindly repeated.

Confirmed Assistant successors retain a usable draft editor, loaded history and reading state. Saved drafts follow only that Assistant's recorded lineage, including after restart; submitted commands and history references keep exact identities. Cursors and logical positions retain native sources, whose decimal position keys decode through tagged JSON replies. Retired rows stay read-only and context retirement does not run Agent archive cleanup.

RAGFlow component operations check the running Docker-compatible engine and Docker Compose before installation effects. Unavailable prerequisites use shared inline feedback without runtime installation, launch or installation guidance. Install prepares managed nightly with compatible Infinity and its private service account and opens the existing model editor if no model settings are saved. The row distinguishes installed service from configured Memory. Empty required fields block submission, edits refresh the form and clear its old error, and complete input gets validation on explicit submission. Save is the single submit action and verifies both models before updating either provider instance. Expanding installed RAGFlow opens the editor directly for independent extraction and embedding model IDs, OpenAI-compatible Base URLs and optional private API keys; native verification precedes saving and dedicated Memory setup. No model runtime or model weights are installed. The editor leaves saved keys blank and keeps each model's key only at its unchanged Base URL; loopback URLs map to the Docker host internally. Indexed Memory retains its embedding model and endpoint. Service connection and derived scopes are automatic, chat import starts off with an independent switch when Memory is ready, and empty dataset scopes disable knowledge retrieval. Collapsing and reopening preserves unsaved input; Cancel discards it and editor errors and collapses the component.

External Memory contexts disable native memory generation, use and the memories feature, set native memory mode disabled and preserve that policy on cold resume. The retiring current thread gets disabled memory mode without deleting existing native memories or editing shared defaults and unrelated Agents.

RAGFlow requests enforce exact scopes, bounded time and size, and HTTP plus business-result checks. Completed public chat imports run one at a time outside the actor. Unknown effects are not automatically resent; queued extraction is not searchable completion.

Database, HTTP, desktop, wire and selected-native fixtures cover teams, wakes, delegation authority, context/import receipts, original dialogue, three fresh contexts with isolated memory, usable drafts across renewal/restart, nonempty source-map response decoding and the shared locked-input presentation. These fixtures do not qualify a live RAGFlow instance or an installed desktop app.

A saved Assistant mandate requests safe context renewal even with periodic renewal disabled. Chat import starts a new opt-in boundary when the external instance, Memory or user scope changes, so earlier pending exchanges are not exported into a new user namespace.

Assistant context history skips internal realtime delegation and intermediate commentary, retains public messages and native turn anchors, and preserves inherited native reasoning effort in fresh contexts.

HTTP Memory setup fixtures cover missing default models without publishing a Memory credential, exact-name recovery after a lost creation reply, and origin-bound credentials with private file modes. Idle setup has no first user event. Managed-service fixtures cover unavailable container prerequisites without storage changes, image pulls or service startup, loopback-only exposure, absence of model installation, custom endpoint paths and names, loopback translation and project-scoped Uninstall without volume removal. The model editor fixtures check blank saved-key fields, same-endpoint key retention, source invalidation, draft preservation, empty-submit blocking, explicit URL validation and input-driven form updates.

First Assistant setup seeds the existing per-Agent next-message choices from the available displayed model and effort, the new-conversation permission default and the shared speed preference. The configured first send carries them without changing the previous Agent or its saved draft.

RAGFlow uses shared component lifecycle controls and displays its complete server-reported version. Receipts and the UI retain the original server version directly. Update retains models, credentials, data and the saved import choice; Uninstall clears the Assistant connection and stops only the owned Compose project while retaining volumes and private installation identity for reinstall.
RAGFlow configuration requires an origin-bound private component credential reference; the service reads that credential file for Memory calls and has no environment-variable credential path.
